# Demo Project

A tiny project used by the static demo to exercise the file explorer, Markdown
preview, Git status/diff, tables, Mermaid and the image viewer.

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

| Area | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Files | text, Markdown, images, tables |
| Git | modified files and diffs |
| Chat | tool calls and changed-file chips |

```mermaid
graph TD
  Br

Welcome! This is a static demo of **Pi Web** — the browser UI for the pi coding agent.

The screen has four areas:

| Area | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| Left sidebar | Sessions, projects and the file explorer |
| Chat | The conversation, model, reasoning level and tool preset |
| Top bar | History, export, branches, system prompt and tools |
| Right panel | Files and terminals in tabs |

```mermaid
graph LR
  Browser --> Server
  Server --> Agent
```

skills.name: git-pullkeep
skills.description: Prefer `git pullkeep` over `git pull` / `git pull --rebase --autostash` whenever a repository has uncommitted changes. Pulls while parking only the blocking files in a labelled temp commit; keeps staged state, untracked files, and every other dirty file untouched. Use when a pull fails with "local changes would be overwritten", when syncing machines that carry local edits, or when autostash/stash-pop keeps causing conflicts.

> The demo never touches a real repository.
